BearerAuth.description: Supabase JWT token in Authorization: Bearer header

ServiceRole.description: Supabase service role key for admin and service endpoints

CookieAuth.name: mnemom_session
CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie issued by /v1/auth/sign-in (or the SSO / email-callback flows). The value is an AES-256-GCM-encrypted blob of {access_token, refresh_token, issued_at, auth_method}. Browser clients include this automatically with `credentials: "include"`.

LicenseJwtAuth.description: License JWT (HS256, HMAC-signed with LICENSE_SIGNING_SECRET). Used by self-hosted deployment instances to authenticate `/v1/deployments/heartbeat`. Not interchangeable with the Supabase user JWT.

agent_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of `SHA256(apiKey + '|' + agentName)` for named agents, or `SHA256(apiKey)` for unnamed singleton agents. The gateway computes the same value on each request and uses it as the lookup key. See [Agent Identity](https://docs.mnemom.ai/concepts/agent-identity#agent_hash--the-canonical-identity-hash).

card_json.description: Full alignment card JSON per AAP spec

ApiKeyScope.description: Capability-based scope (ADR-049). `gateway` permits gateway-worker traffic; `api:read` and `api:write` permit identity-scoped GET and write endpoints respectively; `admin:org` permits org-admin operations on orgs the bearer owns/admins (per-request membership re-check); `admin:platform` permits `/v1/admin/*` Mnemom-staff operations (per-request staff-role re-check). The legacy `api` scope is accepted for backward compatibility and aliased to `api:read` + `api:write` at the auth gate; new keys should use the canonical vocabulary.

key.description: Full secret key, only returned on creation

scopes.description: Capabilities granted to this key. Default for new keys is `["gateway", "api:read", "api:write"]`. Admin scopes (`admin:org`, `admin:platform`) are opt-in and gated by the requester's role at mint time. See [API Keys → Scope vocabulary](https://docs.mnemom.ai/guides/api-keys#scope-vocabulary).

WebhookEndpoint.description: Webhook endpoint with signing secret (only returned on creation and secret rotation)

signing_secret.description: 32-byte hex-encoded HMAC signing secret. Only returned on creation and rotation.

event_types.description: Subscribed event types. Empty array means all events.

WebhookEndpointPublic.description: Webhook endpoint without signing secret (used in list and get responses)

last_response_status.description: HTTP status code from last delivery attempt

SigningKeyInfo.description: Ed25519 signing key metadata. Public keys are used to verify IntegrityCertificate signatures.

is_active.description: Whether the key is currently in use for new signatures

IntegrityCertificate.description: Machine-readable cryptographic certificate for an integrity checkpoint. Modeled on C2PA content credentials and W3C Verifiable Credentials.

subject.description: Identifies the checkpoint this certificate attests to

thinking_block_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the thinking block

card_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the Alignment Card

combined_commitment.description: SHA-256 of all input fields concatenated

signed_payload.description: Deterministic JSON string that was signed

merkle.description: Null if Merkle proof was not present in the certificate

OrgConscienceValue.description: A custom conscience value for an organization

enforcement_mode.description: Default enforcement mode for the policy

classification.description: Classification of the fault line type

agents_missing.description: Agent IDs that are missing this requirement

impact.description: Estimated impact if the failure occurs

failure_modes.description: Ranked list of potential failure modes

overall_risk_level.description: Overall risk level for the team

confidence.description: Confidence level of the forecast (0.0 to 1.0)

OnChainAnchorResult.description: Result of an on-chain Merkle root anchoring operation.

merkle_root.description: Hex-encoded Merkle root hash that was anchored

block_number.description: Block number in which the transaction was included

gas_used.description: Gas consumed by the anchoring transaction

chain.description: Blockchain network where the anchor was created

agent_ids.description: Agent IDs included in this anchor

anchored_at.description: Timestamp when the anchor was created

User.description: Supabase user shape. Fields beyond `id` and `email` are passthrough.

PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON.description: WebAuthn registration options (base64url-encoded per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON serialization).

RegistrationResponseJSON.description: Browser's `navigator.credentials.create()` response, JSON-serialized per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON form.

UnifiedAlignmentCard.description: UC-4 unified alignment card (ADR-008). Authored in YAML or JSON; composed server-side with platform defaults, org template, and active exemptions before storage.

card_id.description: Card row id. Server-assigned on PUT (`ac-{uuid}`).

agent_id.description: Target agent id. On PUT, server overwrites to match the URL path.

UnifiedProtectionCard.description: UC-4 unified protection card (ADR-008). Safe House thresholds + trusted-source policy for a single agent.

CompositionMetadata.description: System-managed block describing which scope sources merged into the canonical card. Only returned when `?include_composition=true`.

AgentExemption.description: A single exemption row relaxing an org-template floor for one agent (UC-4, ADR-008).

status.description: Always `active` in UC-4 (forward-compat stub for future dual-control approval workflow).

DeletionRequestStatus.description: Tracks progress of the async GDPR Art. 17 deletion cascade (ADR-021).

DisagreementReview.description: Row from `disagreement_reviews` — a human-adjudicable action that failed to find consensus during enforcement.

action.description: Action the reviewer proposes to add to `autonomy_envelope.bounded_actions`.

ReputationScore.description: Agent reputation row computed by the reputation worker's 6-hour cron. Grade alphabet: `AAA AA+ AA A+ A B+ B C+ C D NR` (NR = not-rated, insufficient data). Score is an integer 0–1000.

a2a_trust_extension.description: A2A trust extension for interop. Only present on `GET /reputation/{agent_id}` (not on batch/compare rows).

RiskAssessment.description: Individual risk assessment row (`ra-…`). Produced by `POST /risk/assess`.

TeamRiskAssessment.description: Team risk assessment row (`tra-…`). Produced by `POST /risk/assess/team`. Three-pillar result (portfolio + coherence + concentration) with weakest-link and Shapley attribution per member.

QuarantineItem.description: Quarantined message row. Stores only `content_hash` — the original plaintext is not retained once the message is quarantined.

SafeHousePattern.description: Row from `sh_threat_patterns`. `label: "benign"` patterns are used to suppress false positives; `label: "malicious"` patterns add to L1/L2 detection.

SafeHouseCanary.description: Canary credential planted in an agent context. `canary_value` is only returned on creation.

SafeHouseEvaluation.description: Row from `sh_evaluations` — one screening decision (inbound or outbound). `threats` and `detector_scores` depend on detector config.

SelfHostedDeployment.description: A self-hosted Mnemom deployment registered by an org.

TrustEdge.description: Directed trust-relationship edge between two agents (CLPI Phase 3). Used by the trust-topology RPC and the team reputation scorer.

GovernanceSignalScope.description: Scope at which the signal is produced and routed (ADR-048 §1).

GovernanceSignalSource.description: Source detector for the signal. Closed enum per ADR-048 §1.

GovernanceNotificationState.description: Per-channel dispatch state populated by the notification dispatcher.

GovernanceSignal.description: A governance signal row — operator-actionable observation per ADR-048.

GovernanceCoverageReport.description: Coverage rollup across the org's teams.

Posture.description: Trust posture row (mig 173). Library row; revisions are versioned bodies stored separately.

current_revision_id.description: FK to trust_posture_revisions; NULL only mid-create.

PostureRevision.description: Versioned posture body. Immutable by handler discipline (forward-only).

body.description: Composition inputs: alignment_card, protection_card, integrity, autonomy, etc.

PostureEffects.description: Analytics rollup: cells affected by this posture revision over a window.

TeamEffectivePosture.description: Composed posture currently in effect for a team (alignment + protection + integrity merged from posture body, team templates, and per-agent exemptions).

SidebandAdvisoryRow.description: Legacy pre-cutover sideband row. Post ADR-048 cutover, sideband.* sources are written to governance_signals; this query endpoint surveys what historical rows remain in pending_advisories. Sunsetting; clients should consume governance_signals directly.

SidebandCoverageReport.description: Per-team rollup of sideband.* finding counts over a window. Operator dashboard input.

TeamAdmin.description: Team-admin grant — allows a non-org-admin user to administer one team.

ApiKeyWhoAmI.description: Caller introspection — which API key authenticated this request, what scopes it carries, what org/agent it's bound to.

OperatorAttestationRequest.description: Sign an operator-issued attestation about a checkpoint, signal, or audit-relevant event. Returns an Ed25519-signed envelope binding the operator's identity to the asserted statement at the asserted time.

get.description: List all agents owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of agents to return (max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of agents to skip for pagination

total.description: Total number of agents owned by the user

get.summary: Graph of the caller's agents + trust edges
get.description: Returns a `{nodes, edges}` graph of every agent linked to the authenticated user, suitable for dashboard topology rendering. **Feature-gated:** requires the `trust_topology` feature flag on the caller's plan. Falls back to `{nodes: [], edges: []}` if the backing RPC fails.

402.description: Plan does not include the `trust_topology` feature.

200.description: Agent details. Private agents return a limited response to non-owners.

put.description: Update the name of an agent you own.

name.description: New agent name. 2-32 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens only.

403.description: Not the owner of this agent

delete.description:
Tombstone an agent and asynchronously cascade deletion across all agent-owned records (traces, integrity checkpoints, drift alerts, reclassifications, etc.) per [ADR-021](https://github.com/mnemom/scale/blob/main/decisions/ADR-021-gdpr-cascade.md). The request returns `202 Accepted` immediately with a `deletion_request_id`; poll [GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/deletion-status](/api-reference/endpoint/get-agents-agent-id-deletion-status) or subscribe to the deletion webhook for cascade progress.

Idempotent: re-DELETE on a tombstoned agent returns the existing `deletion_request_id` with the current status.

202.description: Deletion accepted; cascade will run asynchronously

deletion_request_id.description: Stable identifier for this deletion request; pass to deletion-status to poll progress.

status.description: Initial state is `tombstoned` (synchronous part); cascade transitions to `in_progress` then `completed` (or `failed`).

completed_at.description: Set once the async cascade finishes. `null` while in flight.

403.description: Not the owner of this agent

get.summary: Get the agent's canonical alignment card
get.description: Returns the UC-4 unified alignment card. Response is content-negotiated — YAML by default, or JSON with `Accept: application/json`. Pass `?include_composition=true` to include the `_composition` metadata block describing which scope sources (platform / org template / agent card / exemptions) were merged. See ADR-008.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Response format. YAML is canonical; JSON is returned only on explicit `application/json`.

404.description: No canonical alignment card found for this agent. Publish one with `PUT /agents/{agent_id}/alignment-card`.

put.summary: Publish or replace the agent's alignment card
put.description: Accepts YAML (`text/yaml`, `application/yaml`) or JSON (`application/json`). Body is the full UnifiedAlignmentCard; server-side composition merges it with platform defaults, the org alignment template, and any active exemptions, then stores the canonical composed card. Requires `Idempotency-Key` — replays within 24 hours return the stored result. Body cap: 128 KiB. See ADR-008 and ADR-023.

200.description: Card accepted, composed, and stored. Body is the post-composition canonical card.

400.description: Card failed schema validation (e.g. missing `values.declared`, bad enforcement mode, unknown escalation action).

post.summary: Dry-run compose for an agent alignment card draft
post.description: Composes Platform defaults + active org alignment template with the supplied draft agent alignment card and returns the composed canonical card plus per-field conflicts where the draft was tightened by an upstream scope. Read-only; no DB writes; no `Idempotency-Key` required. Body cap: 128 KiB. See ADR-039.

field.description: Dotted path of the field whose draft value was overridden by a higher scope.

draft_value.description: The value the caller submitted in the draft.

effective_value.description: The value after composition with higher scopes.

400.description: Draft failed schema validation. Body is `{ ok: false, errors: [...] }`.

put.description: Replace an agent's avatar image. Requires the authenticated principal to be the agent's owner (`agents.user_id == auth.sub`). Old avatar is replaced; storage cleanup happens server-side.

file.description: Avatar image. Validated for MIME type and size before upload.

avatar_url.description: Public URL of the uploaded avatar (CDN-served).

400.description: Bad upload (missing file, unsupported MIME, file too large)

403.description: Not authorized to update this resource's avatar

get.description: Retrieve the history of all alignment card amendments for the specified agent. Card amendments are changes to the agent's alignment card that were triggered by reclassifications, policy changes, or manual edits.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of amendments to return

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of amendments to skip for pagination

hash_proof.description: SHA-256 hash of agent API key

get.description: Export a comprehensive compliance record for the agent including all checkpoints, reclassifications, card amendments, and score history. Returns a structured document suitable for regulatory audits and compliance reviews.

get.summary: Poll the status of a pending agent deletion
get.description: Returns the most-recent `deletion_request` row for the agent. Status progresses: `tombstoned` → `phase_N_complete` → `kv_cleared` → `pseudonymized` → `complete` (or `failed` at any phase). Used to track the async GDPR Art. 17 cascade kicked off by `DELETE /agents/{agent_id}`. See ADR-021.

404.description: No deletion request has been filed for this agent.

get.summary: List active exemptions for an agent
get.description: Exemptions relax an org-level template floor for a single agent (replaces the old coarse `org_card_exempt` boolean). Only non-expired, status=active entries are returned. Any org member (owner/admin/member/viewer/auditor) may read. See ADR-008 (UC-4).

post.summary: Grant an exemption to an agent
post.description: Requires org `owner` or `admin` of the agent's org. Personal agents (no org) cannot have exemptions and receive 400. Reason is required (20–500 chars). `expires_at` defaults to +90 days if omitted; pass `null` for permanent (opt-in only). Requires `Idempotency-Key`. Emits a `agent.exemption.granted` webhook and writes a governance audit row. Triggers a recompose of the agent's canonical cards. See ADR-008.

exempt_patterns.description: Specific patterns to exempt within the section. `null` exempts the entire section.

reason.description: Business justification for the exemption (required, ≥20 chars).

expires_at.description: Expiry. Omit for default +90 days. `null` = permanent (explicit opt-in).

400.description: Validation error, or agent has no org.

delete.description: Hard-deletes the exemption row (the governance audit log is the permanent record). Requires org `owner`/`admin`. Idempotency-Key required. Emits `agent.exemption.revoked` and recomposes the agent. See ADR-008.

404.description: Exemption not found for this agent.

draft_value.description: The value the caller submitted in the draft.

effective_value.description: The value after composition with higher scopes.

post.summary: Re-bind agent to a new API key
post.description:
Updates the agent's key binding to a new provider API key hash. The agent ID, traces, alignment card, integrity score, and trust edges are fully preserved.

**Security model**: Your API key is hashed on your device (SHA-256) before transmission — the raw key is never sent to Mnemom servers.

**Named agents**: If this agent was registered with a name (via `x-mnemom-agent`), hash the new key as `SHA256(newKey + '|' + agentName)` before submitting.

**Conflict**: If the new key was already used and auto-created a new agent, the endpoint returns `409` with the conflicting agent ID.

new_key_hash.description: First 16 hex characters of SHA256(newApiKey) for unnamed agents, or SHA256(newApiKey + '|' + agentName) for named agents. Compute client-side — do not transmit the raw key.

key_prefix.description: First 16 characters of the new provider API key. Stored for display — not sensitive. If provided, returned in the response.

200.description: Agent successfully re-bound to the new key.

409.description: The new key is already bound to another agent.

Re-evaluate AIP checkpoints against updated card

get.summary: List disagreement reviews for an agent

400.description: Review is not in a state that can be applied, or has no proposed amendment.

404.description: Review or alignment card not found.

List trust edges from or to an agent
get.description: Returns trust-relationship edges that the agent participates in. `direction=outbound` returns edges originating from this agent; `inbound` returns edges pointing at this agent; `both` (default) deduplicates.

post.summary: Create a trust edge from this agent to another
post.description: Caller must own the `from` agent (or be an admin). `weight` is clamped to [0, 1] with default 0.5. Returns 409 if an edge already exists in the same direction.

400.description: Missing `to_agent` or self-loop.

403.description: Caller does not own the source agent.

404.description: Source or target agent not found.

409.description: A trust edge already exists between these agents in this direction.

delete.description: Caller must own the source agent (`from_agent`) or be an admin. Either source or target agent id may appear in the path.

403.description: Caller does not own the source agent.

404.description: Edge not found, or the edge does not touch this agent.

post.description:
Checks whether a given API key hash matches the key currently bound to this agent. The raw key is hashed client-side — only the hash is transmitted.

**Named agents**: hash as `SHA256(key + '|' + agentName)` before submitting.

Returns `key_prefix` of the registered key regardless of match result — useful for debugging.

key_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA256(apiKey) or SHA256(apiKey + '|' + agentName) for named agents.

bound.description: True if the submitted hash matches the registered key.

key_prefix.description: First 16 chars of the registered key, or null if not yet captured.

get.summary: Count completed ZK proofs for an agent
get.description: Public endpoint. Returns the count of `verdict_proofs` rows in `completed` state across all of the agent's checkpoints. Intended for embeddable verification widgets.

items.description: Array of analysis requests (same shape as POST /analyze body)

post.description: Mints a new personal API key. The full secret is returned in the `key` field — capture it now, it is not retrievable again. Scopes use the capability-based vocabulary (ADR-049); the default scope set is `["gateway", "api:read", "api:write"]`. Admin scopes (`admin:org`, `admin:platform`) are opt-in and rejected at mint time if the requester does not hold the corresponding role.

name.description: Friendly name for the key (e.g., "ci-prod", "local-dev"). Capped at 100 characters; longer names are truncated server-side.

scopes.description: Capability set for this key. If omitted, the API substitutes the default. Admin scopes (`admin:org`, `admin:platform`) are gated by the requester's current role and return HTTP 403 at mint time if the requester is not eligible.

400.description: Validation error — typically an unknown scope name. The error message lists the valid scopes.

403.description: Mint-time ceiling violation — `admin:platform` requested by a non-staff user, or `admin:org` requested by a user who is not owner/admin of any organization. The error body identifies which scope was rejected.

get.summary: Inspect the calling API key (caller introspection)
get.description: Returns the resolved API key's identity: its scopes (capabilities), bound user/agent/org, and last-used metadata. Useful for clients to confirm scope and identity before issuing privileged calls.

post.description: Atomically mints a replacement key with the same `name` and `scopes` as the original, then immediately revokes the old key. The full new secret is returned in the response — this is your only chance to capture it. Old key is invalid as soon as the response is returned; if you need overlap with an in-flight deploy, **create a second key first** via `POST /api-keys`, ship your code, then `DELETE` the old key. Rotation is for the suspect/compromised-key case where overlap is the opposite of what you want.
